g.text: NATIONAL AERONAUTICS AND SPACE ADMINISTRATION • MANNED SPACECRAFT CENTER
PRIMARY HARDWARE SUBSYSTEMS, PROPELLANT TANKAGE & EVA EXPERIMENT COMPARTMENTS
Forward gear strut (+Z Axis). 9-rung titanium assembly.
Stainless steel lunar plaque affixed between rungs 3 & 4.
Quadrant II. Deployed by Pete Conrad via lanyard.
Carried Westinghouse color TV camera, tools, rock boxes.
9,870 lbf max thrust. Deep throttle range 10% - 100%.
Ablative skirt & titanium radiation cooled columbium bell.
External outrigger mount. Encased 44,500 Ci of Plutonium-238.
Fuel capsule extracted with DRT tool and inserted into RTG generator.
Carried folded Central Station, PSE, LSM, SWS, SIDE.
Carried 130m NW by Alan Bean using barbell mast carrier.
Triggered blue "LUNAR CONTACT" cockpit light at touchdown.
E • DECLASSIFIED ARCHIVE PROFILE • NASA MSC
